article.title: Food has returned to Gaza’s markets, but most people still cannot afford to eat
article.author: Tareq S. Hajjaj
article.content: Prices have fallen sharply since the famine of 2025, but with purchasing power destroyed by nearly three years of war and displacement, food on the shelves remains out of reach for the majority of Gaza's population.
